name: cloudxr-metrics-hub
description: Local WebSocket hub and viewer page for CloudXR client metrics
author: NVIDIA Corporation

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --outfile=build/bundle.js --format=esm --platform=browser && esbuild src/logs.ts --bundle --outfile=build/logs.bundle.js --format=esm --platform=browser && cp index.html build/index.html && cp logs.html build/logs.html
scripts.dev: npm run build && tsx watch server.ts
scripts.dev:http: npm run build && tsx watch server.ts --http
